# nobadleads

> Upload an Excel of leads, get an ICP score and three cold email openers for each, powered by website screenshots and GPT-4o.

nobadleads scores prospects from a spreadsheet against your ideal customer profile and writes three cold email openers per lead. The scoring uses a vision model that actually reads the prospect's website, not just firmographics. No CRM, no demo, no setup beyond pasting your ICP in plain English.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.nobadleads.com/): What the product does in one screen.
- [Score your leads](https://www.nobadleads.com/tool): The tool itself — upload a spreadsheet, get scored leads back.
- [Blog](https://www.nobadleads.com/blog): Practical playbooks on cold outreach, ICP scoring, and AI-driven prospecting.
